cases.name: Valid small PNG
cases.expected_secure_behavior: Authorized upload succeeds; only owner can retrieve original and thumbnail

cases.name: HTML with allowed PDF extension
cases.expected_secure_behavior: Reject type mismatch; never return attacker HTML inline on application origin

cases.name: Spoofed PDF MIME
cases.expected_secure_behavior: Reject based on actual content, not the claimed MIME

cases.name: Traversal name
cases.expected_secure_behavior: Reject or normalize display name; storage remains under fixed root with generated key

cases.name: Windows path and alternate stream names
cases.expected_secure_behavior: No client filename becomes a disk path on either platform

cases.name: Double extension and unsupported types
cases.expected_secure_behavior: Unsupported final extensions rejected; renamed content cannot bypass type inspection

cases.name: Byte limit boundaries
cases.generation: Descriptor only; no large allocation performed
cases.expected_secure_behavior: Enforce file policy and independent multipart overhead ceiling before unbounded reads

cases.name: Chunked and multipart exhaustion
cases.expected_secure_behavior: Bound bytes, part counts, field memory, buffering and time at edge and application

cases.name: Image expansion and decoder abuse
cases.generation: Descriptors only; no bomb or exploit bytes created
cases.expected_secure_behavior: Bound decoded pixels, frames, CPU, memory and elapsed time in isolated processing

cases.name: Cross-user and anonymous reads
cases.expected_secure_behavior: Owner succeeds; B and anonymous denied even with known ID

cases.name: Same filename across owners
cases.expected_secure_behavior: Different immutable object keys; neither original or thumbnail is overwritten

cases.name: Scan lifecycle failures
cases.generation: Mock states only; no malware included
cases.expected_secure_behavior: Only clean final object may be read; failures remain quarantined

cases.name: Processing external resources
cases.generation: Descriptors only; no network or filesystem attack attempted
cases.expected_secure_behavior: Unsupported formats rejected; enabled processors cannot fetch internal URLs or resolve external entities

cases.name: Direct origin and cache bypass
request_variants: warm owner cache then read as B
cases.expected_secure_behavior: Privacy policy enforced on every path; caches and URL expiry cannot bypass it

cases.name: CSRF and upload authentication
request_variants: cross-origin multipart form with session cookie
cases.expected_secure_behavior: Unauthenticated and forged cross-origin requests denied

cases.name: Quota and cleanup
cases.expected_secure_behavior: Bound cost and storage; failures leave no readable object and temporary files are reclaimed
